about.title: Precision Packaging Built for Pharma
about.description: Product Armor Packaging Pvt Ltd is a dedicated manufacturer of HDPE pharmaceutical bottles, Child Resistant (CR) caps and Continuous Thread (CT) caps. We combine cross-industry engineering expertise with sustainable manufacturing processes to deliver world-class packaging at unparalleled value. Our commitment to quality, compliance and environmental responsibility sets us apart in every batch we produce.

products.name: HDPE Pharmaceutical Bottles
products.description: High-density polyethylene bottles engineered for pharmaceutical storage. Available in multiple sizes, colours and neck finishes to suit your formulation requirements.
features: USP Class VI compliant HDPE resin
Multiple colour options including amber and white

products.name: Child Resistant Caps
products.description: Push-and-turn child resistant closures meeting global safety standards. Designed to protect children while remaining accessible to adults.

products.name: Continuous Thread Caps
products.description: Standard CT closures for pharmaceutical and nutraceutical applications. Available with various liner options for optimal seal integrity.
features: Induction seal, foam and EPE liner options
